subject: Urgent: Hosted capacity incident — next steps for Dedicated/Private
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sabrina Lopez <sabrina@acmeai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-23T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & deployment clarification

Hi Sabrina —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment before next steps: 

- Current usage: ~200 QPS at peak, mostly short chats (4–8 tokens response).
- Pain points: intermittent latency spikes and 5xx errors during sudden traffic bursts; internal SRE is concerned about tail latency and cost predictability.
- Desired outcome: consistent <200ms p95 and a predictable cost per 1M tokens.

A few questions to help us qualify the right deployment: Hosted API should be fine if you want minimal ops and can tolerate some contention during bursts. Dedicated capacity gives predictable throughput and isolation (we can reserve GPUs and set guaranteed concurrency). Private (VPC/on-prem) is only needed if you need VPC-only networking, strict data residency, or an on-prem appliance.

Can you confirm: 1) whether the traffic spikes are predictable or incident-driven, and 2) whether you have any hard requirement for VPC/data residency or an on-prem option?

If it's mostly incident-driven (unplanned spikes causing outages) we can fast-track a Dedicated trial while we size capacity and evaluate fallback policies. If you need help capturing evidence of recent incidents, send over the last 72h logs and we'll pull p95/p99 and error-rate reports.

Next steps we propose if you're available:
- Share 72h logs / SLOs (you)
- Quick joint runbook review and migration checklist (we)
- 30-minute kickoff for Dedicated trial + SLA timeline (we + you)

Attaching a short migration playbook and our Dedicated SLA PDF for reference.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: migration_playbook_v1.docx, SLA_Redwood_Dedicated.pdf

From: Sabrina Lopez <sabrina@acmeai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acmeai.com
Date: 2026-06-25T03:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & deployment clarification

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap. Apologies for the urgent note — our SRE woke us up at 2:30am with alerts. Over the last 8 hours we saw repeated 502s and p95 latency jump to ~1.2s during a customer campaign. This is incident-driven (unexpected traffic from a partner) and it's blocking us. We need either a migration to Dedicated or an emergency capacity boost.

We don't have strict on-prem or residency requirements right now; primary need is predictability and isolation until our traffic normalizes.

I can share logs (we're zipping them now) and our traffic spike window. Procurement is looped in for quick approvals.

Can you please advise the fastest path — Dedicated trial or some expedited Hosted capacity allocation? We need the decision within the day if possible.

— Sabrina
Sabrina Lopez
SRE Lead, Acme AI
sabrina@acmeai.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sabrina Lopez <sabrina@acmeai.com>, procurement@acmeai.com
Date: 2026-06-25T05:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: Hosted capacity incident — next steps for Dedicated/Private

Team —

Escalating this as a potential Hosted->Dedicated conversion. Quick assessment and suggested runbook: 

1) Immediate mitigation (hours):
   - Short-term: enable burst capacity on Hosted for Acme (if available in region) to stop 5xxs.
   - Parallel: provision a minimal Dedicated pool (2x T4s as starting point) to validate throughput with their workloads.
2) Data gathering (now):
   - Request: Sabrina to send the last 72h logs and the peak QPS windows (they said they're zipping).
   - Connor: we'll need to run a quick replay job to validate KV cache behavior and token throughput.
3) Migration path (24–72h):
   - Fast-track Dedicated trial for 7–14 days with monitoring hooks and traffic split (20% -> 100%).
   - If Acme requires VPC-only, we will propose Redwood Private (VPC) — that's a longer lead time (weeks) and requires procurement.
4) Commercials and approvals:
   - Rishi: can you prep a one-page amendment for a short-term Dedicated reservation and emergency billing terms?

Marissa — please send the mutual action plan and the list of required items for Procurement. Sabrina — thanks for looping procurement; if they can pre-approve the emergency PO that will help speed provisioning.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
laura@redwoodinference.com

[Note: forwarding incident_logs.zip to infra queue and starting a replay-run request]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sabrina Lopez <sabrina@acmeai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@acmeai.com
Date: 2026-06-25T07:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: Hosted capacity incident — next steps for Dedicated/Private

Sabrina —

Appreciate the quick response and the logs. Attached is a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a Migration Playbook to get you from Hosted -> Dedicated in an expedited fashion. TL;DR plan:

- Day 0 (today): Confirm PO/approval. Enable short-term burst (if possible) to reduce errors.
- Day 1: Provision Dedicated trial (2x T4), configure routing and monitoring hooks. Start traffic split (10% -> 50%).
- Day 2–3: Full cutover if metrics stable (p95 < 200ms, error-rate < 0.5%).

Checklist for Procurement / SRE to return (attachments + items):
- Signed emergency amendment or PO (can be digital, see DocuSign link below)
- 72h logs (received)
- Peak QPS and concurrency target (please confirm)
- Any compliance/regulatory restrictions (none noted)

Attachments: MAP_quickstart.pdf (included in migration_playbook_v1.docx) and SLA_Redwood_Dedicated.pdf.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/REDWOOD-ACME-EMERGENCY
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/DEAL-ACME-1427

If Procurement can sign the amendment within a few hours, we can start provisioning immediately and have a Dedicated trial running within 8–12 hours. Connor will validate performance during the trial.

I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff at 11:00 PT — please confirm availability.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: migration_playbook_v1.docx, SLA_Redwood_Dedicated.pdf
